what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/longhorizon/spec.md, tasks/longhorizon/dev.json (examples only, none reused) and the tool/checker code in lab/core.py and lab/validate_tasks.py.

Wrote 21 tool-mode tasks (max_steps 8, reference 4-6 tool calls plus final) with a generator script: kv pointer chains, file pointer chains, file-to-kv-to-kv lookups, instruction and movement files that drive kv or file updates, result files and deletion of processed files.

Each negative drops or mishandles one step (stops the chain one hop early, follows an off-chain entry, omits the kv_set, omits the delete, ignores a correction line, forgets the fee, skips a chained operation).
Did not run the model on any task (held-out), did not read other generators' files, did not edit lab/ or artifacts/, did not use git.
verification: Every expected answer and end state is computed in the generator script by simulating the chain or movements in Python (with asserts), independently of the reference steps.
Each reference and negative is replayed through core.reference_episode: reference scores 1 with zero tool errors, negative scores 0.
Extra asserts: every reference uses only the task's tools, has 4-6 tool calls, includes a read_file or at least 3 kv_get hops; all 21 subthemes are distinct; prompt plus env is 367-646 characters.

Every task checks the end state (env_equals / env_absent) for each key or file that must change plus at least one untouched distractor, or tool_called with ok_only for the required chain reads on read-only tasks.
not_done: No model pilot was run (held-out by design), so the easy/medium/hard labels are estimates from the spec's baseline observations, not measured.
